public.title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
public.description: Simulate a word dictionary. Operations are ["addWord", word] returning null, or ["search", pattern] returning whether a stored word matches. A dot matches exactly one lowercase ASCII letter; other pattern characters are literal lowercase letters. Words may be empty, at most 30 letters; patterns have at most 30 characters. At most 200 operations.
hints: Search candidates must have the same length as the pattern.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Store distinct words and compare each search pattern character by character, treating dots as wildcards. Bounded inputs permit O(operations times words times length) time.
